execution.lifecycle_basis: Frozen plan specifies fresh process/engine and common warmup/reset; as-run launcher records separate serial CLI invocations. Stage timestamps are observed execution evidence, at one-second resolution.
execution.limits: chain includes lifecycle/startup/idle; process wall includes initialization; makespans exclude initialization; none is GPU kernel time or paid utilization

apc.unit: paired per-seed four-task mean E2E seconds

queue_aware.unit: paired per-seed four-task mean E2E seconds

protocol.authorization: User explicitly requested rerunning validation after merging PR5/PR6 on 2026-09-09.

between_block_foreground_ci.unit: one four-task mean per method per seed; paired method differences across four seeds

protocol.design: Post-merge repeat of the original four-seed/four-method Williams matrix, same seeds/order/workload. These seeds are already evaluated, not newly held-out. Fresh processes and common warmup/reset, same physical single GPU within this new matrix.
protocol.scope_limit: Merged-main revalidation on one fixed workload stratum and the SAME four previously evaluated traffic seeds. Do not pool old/new runs or claim new held-out/general performance evidence. Lifecycle fixes do not imply the old no-go must reverse.
protocol.stop: One GPU lifecycle and exactly the existing16-trace matrix while scientifically valid. Stop for real code/identity/infrastructure failures, preserve evidence, no hidden reruns or added sweeps. No historical artifact overwrite.

scope_limitations: Merged-main revalidation using the SAME previously evaluated traffic seeds: not new held-out evidence; old and new runs are not pooled. One fixed workload stratum; new seeds are not new task templates. Four independent paired seed means, not 64 independent serial tasks. No pooled background SLO or averaged P95 gate; every semantic block must pass. No workload-wide or distribution-free confidence claim. Endogenous scheduling timestamps never enter future-only policy. Preference is not residency or causal savings; owner release is not cache eviction. Nested CPU timers must not be summed.

trace_storage.semantics: Lossless JSON serialization; gzip is preferred when both copies exist. Corrupt gzip is invalid, never replaced silently with a plain copy.
